name: Remote Backup
author: Bo Reese (bobreese)
description: Designate an FPP as a Backup Host and pull rsync backups of one or more MultiSync remotes onto local NVMe/SSD, USB, or SD card storage. Configurable concurrent transfers (up to 8), --dry-run space checks, mirrored deletes, and dated/rolling per-remote backups named like Pi5-20260803.

privacy.summary: Pulls backups from FPP systems you select over SSH onto this device's storage. Optionally emails a status update through FPP's own Email settings after each run.

sends.what: SSH authentication and rsync file-transfer protocol commands - no show content leaves this device, it only pulls content in

sends.to: the address in FPP Settings > Email
sends.what: a short status summary (which remotes succeeded, failed, or were skipped)
sends.why: to notify the operator after a backup run without them checking the Status page

collects.what: a complete copy of each selected remote's /home/fpp/media/ tree, including that remote's own FPP settings file (can contain its UI login password, OS password, SMTP/email password, MQTT password, GitHub personal access token, and tethering PSK, all in plain text) and every other installed plugin's own stored data (which may include that plugin's own API keys or tokens), plus its logs unless excluded
collects.where: the backup destination you configure, in <Hostname>-<date>/

collects.what: if "Include system config" is enabled, a copy of that remote's OS-level network config, including its WiFi password, in a system-config.tar.gz archive alongside its backup
collects.where: the backup destination you configure, in <Hostname>-<date>/system-config.tar.gz

collects.what: a default SSH password, if you set one

systemChanges.what: on the operator's selection of a remote to back up, pushes its own SSH public key into that remote's ~fpp/.ssh/authorized_keys for passwordless backup access (the settings page discloses this before the selection takes effect). On uninstall, it best-effort removes that key from every known remote's authorized_keys again (reachable remotes only) before deleting its local copy of the key.
sets FPP's restartFlag after install/uninstall so its Scheduler commands register/unregister
mounts a USB drive at /mnt/Backups (and optionally /mnt/BackupsCopy) via /etc/fstab for use as a backup destination
installs rsync, jq, openssh-client, sshpass, curl, parted, zip, and exfatprogs via apt-get if not already present

privacy.other: A settings backup file (plugindata/fpp-plugin-RemoteBackup/settings.json.bak) is left behind after uninstall by default, so a reinstall can recover your configuration - remove it yourself, or re-run the uninstall script with --purge-backups, if you want it gone too.
